note: Track breath, step 8 (longer breaths out): the "long-exhale" breathwork set to its longest breath out ("seconds": 16, six rounds), four times the breath in; the text follows the circle and the feel to reach is an even flow to the very end. Kept apart from the intermediate block of this drill, since a choice can't change a tool's seconds.

exercise.title: A long breath out, four times as long
exercise.why: A long phrase is one slow breath out, so a breath out four times as long as the breath in is the longest phrase without its notes.

cells.text:
Press Start in the circle below. Breathe in while the circle grows, then let the air out slowly until it is small again.
Spend the air slowly from the very start of the breath out, so some is left for the end.
Practice until the last seconds of the breath out flow as evenly as the first.
